en.headline: 368 commits, 25 PRs and 58 issues across OpenCode skills and upstream bug
en.teaser: Most work went into asset-inventory releases and meld-deepresearch, while most issues were filed upstream against openchamber and opencode.
en.overview:
### Own repositories

In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` the window was dominated by a long release train running from v1.4.0 through v1.15.0 and the later 1.13.x patches. Each release was small and deliberate: documentation checks were automated in CI, a version-consistency and glossary check were added, the mkdocs Material site gained rendered bilingual sample pages, and the fixed-string glossary grew to seven languages including Korean, Russian, Arabic and Spanish. Later entries added security guards so scanned text is treated as evidence rather than instructions, a registry-first host-command scan, an install path via skills.sh, and a broken-state marker for registered but uninvokable assets. Release notes were reorganised into their own folders and a release-prep script was introduced.

In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, work focused on the profile README and its automation: the copy was switched to English, a 30-day activity card with a daily update workflow was added, and the daily report later moved to rolling updates every two hours with support for a manually supplied date. Fixes made the statistics and their breakdowns consistent, removed deprecated Node 20 runtimes from CI actions, and neutralised the wording of the activity card. A temporary smoke-test issue was opened and closed on the same day.

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` grew from its first tagged release through v0.4.0: the skill gained a SKILL.md with four reference documents, validation scripts and CI, a first-class observations evidence type with C1-C8 fixes, bilingual documentation and a GitHub Pages landing page with light and dark themes. v0.2.0 wrote down the handling of paywalled sources, v0.3.0 split the skill into three cooperating skills including a spreadsheet analysis workflow, and v0.4.0 added a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the six gates.

### Smaller repositories

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` reached its first stable release and then v1.1.0, v1.3.0 and v1.4.0: a plan-aware allocation model with fallback chains, a three-part output body with a data appendix, read-only discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, proxy-aware and atomic JSON helpers, and several rounds of failure-mode and checkpoint-marker clarifications. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` accumulated knowledge notes on OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication, Windows path pitfalls and managed OpenCode behaviour. `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` implemented a skill_management plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions and shipped two release candidates that exercised trusted publishing. `sogeisetsu/myBlog` only received three OpenChamber capture samples.

### Upstream reports

Outside the account, the bulk of activity was upstream issue reporting. 29 issues went to `openchamber/openchamber`, covering multi-run cleanup and orphaned MCP processes, stale-save clobbering of AGENTS.md, missing auto-update manifests, skipped-role turns being merged, model switching that keeps the previous thinking level, and capture resolution on high-DPI displays. 12 issues went to `anomalyco/opencode`, mostly about MiMo models on the Go endpoint rejecting or staling image input, plus worktree removal and a missing Windows CLI entry point. Smaller reports covered OpenCode V2 compatibility for skill plugins, skills install paths pointing at the wrong config directory, listing requests in skill directories, and V1-table session discovery.

No reviews were recorded in the window. The grand totals are 368 commits, 25 pull requests, 58 issues and 0 reviews; the commit figure includes 336 automated commits. Every day of the 30-day window has data. The backfill note applies to 2026-09-20 through 2026-10-01, where issues, reviews and discussions come from search and are approximate, star counts are unavailable and releases cover only the user's own repositories.

highlights.text: v1.7.0 merged: seven languages, a Material docs site and rendered examples.
Three cooperating skills, with a spreadsheet analysis workflow handed off from the core research skill.
First stable release: plan-aware model allocation with fallback chains and a read-only apply gate.
Temporary smoke test of the opencode command, closed after verification.
Deleting a multi-run leaves orphaned MCP child processes and blocks git worktree removal.
MiMo models advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image with a 400.
Robustness fixes for eval parsing, aggregation and install.
Submission of asset-inventory to the agent-skills list.

zh.headline: 本人向 OpenCode 技能与上游报错投入 368 次提交、25 个 PR 和 58 个 issue
zh.teaser: 主要工作量集中在 asset-inventory 的连续发版和 meld-deepresearch 的迭代，问题报告则大多提交给 openchamber 与 opencode。
zh.overview:
### 自有仓库

`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 的时间主要花在从 v1.4.0 到 v1.15.0 以及后续 1.13.x 补丁的连续发版上。每次发版都小而具体：在 CI 中加入文档检查，增加版本一致性与术语表校验，给 mkdocs Material 站点加上可渲染的双语示例页，并把固定文案术语表扩展到英语、中文、日语、韩语、俄语、阿拉伯语和西班牙语七种语言。后续版本增加了安全护栏，让扫描到的文本只作为证据而不被当作指令，改为以注册表为优先的主机命令扫描，接入 skills.sh 安装方式，并为已注册但不可调用的资产新增 broken 状态标记。发布说明迁移到独立目录，并引入了发版准备脚本。

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的工作集中在个人主页 README 及其自动化：文案切换为英文，新增带每日更新工作流的 30 天活动卡片，日报随后改为每两小时滚动更新并支持手动指定日期。修复让统计数字与拆分结果保持一致，从 CI 动作中移除了已弃用的 Node 20 运行时，并统一了活动卡片的中性表述。期间还开了一个临时冒烟测试 issue，当天即关闭。

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 从首个标签版本推进到 v0.4.0：技能加入 SKILL.md 与四份参考文档、校验脚本和 CI，新增一等公民的 observations 证据类型并修复 C1-C8 问题，补充双语文档和带明暗主题的 GitHub Pages 落地页。v0.2.0 写明了付费墙来源的处理规则，v0.3.0 把技能拆成三个协作技能（含表格数据分析工作流），v0.4.0 新增封装六个门禁的 `meld.py` 薄 CLI。

### 小型仓库

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 发布了首个稳定版，随后到 v1.1.0、v1.3.0 和 v1.4.0：按套餐额度分配模型并给出回退链，把输出改成三段正文加数据附录，提供只读的发现与快照摘要脚本，支持代理的原子 JSON 读写助手，并多轮澄清失败模式与检查点标记。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 归档了关于 OpenCode V2 分发、认证、Windows 路径坑和托管 OpenCode 实测的知识笔记。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 实现了带 list、inspect、disable、enable 的 skill_management 插件，并发布两个候选版本验证可信发布流程。`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 只新增了三张 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游报告

账号之外的工作主要是向上游提交问题。提交给 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 29 个 issue 涉及多运行清理与残留 MCP 子进程、AGENTS.md 外部修改后保存被静默覆盖、缺少自动更新清单、跳过角色的消息合并、切换模型后仍保留上一个思考等级，以及高分屏下截图分辨率减半。提交给 `anomalyco/opencode` 的 12 个 issue 多与 Go 端点上 MiMo 模型拒绝或读取过期图片有关，另含 worktree 删除失败和 Windows 端缺少 CLI 入口。其余报告涉及技能插件的 V2 兼容、技能安装路径指向错误配置目录、技能目录收录申请，以及 V1 表结构会话发现。

本窗口没有代码评审记录。总计为 368 次提交、25 个 PR、58 个 issue 和 0 次评审，其中提交数包含 336 次自动提交。30 天窗口内每天都有数据。补充抓取说明适用于 2026-09-20 至 2026-10-01：这些日期的 issue、评审与讨论来自搜索、结果近似，星标数不可用，发布记录仅覆盖本人仓库。

highlights.text: v1.7.0 合并：七种语言、Material 文档站和渲染示例。
拆成三个协作技能，核心研究技能把表格分析工作流交给独立技能。
首个稳定版：按套餐额度分配模型，带回退链和只读应用门禁。
opencode 命令的临时冒烟测试，验证完成后关闭。
删除多运行后残留 MCP 子进程，导致 git worktree 删除失败。
MiMo 模型宣称支持图片输入，但 Go 端点对所有图片返回 400。
加固评测的解析、聚合与安装健壮性。
将 asset-inventory 提交到 agent 技能清单。
